_note: Exercise library (D30). work = seconds per round (gym: estimated time per set); reps shown for gym. Templates are recommended sessions built from library ids; item fields override the exercise defaults.

exercises.name: Jog + dynamic leg swings
exercises.how: Easy jog, then leg swings front/side, walking lunges with a twist. Keep it relaxed.

exercises.name: Hip openers + glute activation
exercises.how: 90/90 hip switches, glute bridges, lateral band-free side steps. Hip and knee insurance.

exercises.name: Build-up sprints (no ball)
exercises.how: 10-15 m at 70%, 80%, 90%. Stop if you feel sharp knee pain.

exercises.name: Juggling
exercises.how: Round 1 right foot, round 2 left foot, round 3 both feet + thighs. Count your best streak.

exercises.name: Sprint + change of direction (no ball)
exercises.how: Sprint 10 m to a marker, plant hard, cut 45-90 degrees, accelerate 5 m. Alternate the cutting foot.

exercises.name: Tight-space close control
exercises.how: Stay inside a 3x3 m square. Soles, inside/outside touches, quick turns. Head up.

exercises.name: Dribble + change direction
exercises.how: Drive the ball between markers: cut, drag-back, step-over. Explode out of every turn. Use your left foot on rounds 2 and 4.

exercises.name: Freestyle dribbling
exercises.how: Free play with the ball: feints, rolls, step-overs, whatever you want to own. Try one new move each round.

exercises.name: 1v1 reaction (voice cues)
exercises.how: Attack a marker as the defender. When you hear LEFT or RIGHT, the defender is committing that way: go the other way and accelerate past.

exercises.name: 1v1 then finish
exercises.how: Same cue game, but finish with a shot after you beat the marker. Alternate feet.

exercises.name: Cool-down: hips, quads, hamstrings, IT band
exercises.how: Hip flexor stretch, quad stretch, hamstring stretch, figure-4 glute stretch, 60 s each side. Breathe slowly.

exercises.name: Wall passes: ground, both feet
exercises.how: 2-3 m from the wall. Round 1 right, 2 left, 3 alternate, 4 one-touch alternate. Pass firm, control with the first touch.

exercises.name: Wall passes: in the air
exercises.how: Throw or volley the ball at the wall and control the rebound out of the air: thigh, instep, chest. Left foot on rounds 2 and 4.

exercises.name: Weak foot (left): receive and pass
exercises.how: Pass off the wall with your left only, receive with your left only. Slow and accurate beats fast and sloppy.

exercises.name: Shooting: stationary
exercises.how: Set the ball, strike low and across the keeper. Alternate right and left. Plant foot next to the ball, head over it.

exercises.name: Shooting: on the move
exercises.how: Dribble 5-8 m, take one touch to set, shoot. Left foot on rounds 2 and 4.

exercises.name: Crossing and passing
exercises.how: Run along the wing, cross or pass to a target. Alternate lofted and driven. Both feet.

exercises.name: Ground passing: one touch
exercises.how: 5-8 m apart, firm pass on the ground. Round 1 right foot, 2 left foot, 3 alternate, 4 move side to side.

exercises.name: Ground passing: two touch
exercises.how: First touch sets the ball to the side, second touch passes. Open up your body to the pass.

exercises.name: Air control: one touch back
exercises.how: Partner tosses or lofts the ball. Control or volley it straight back. Thigh, instep, chest. Alternate feet.

exercises.name: Passing while moving
exercises.how: Pass and move along a line, one touch. Keep the pace up, call for the ball.

exercises.name: 1v1 with partner
exercises.how: Real defender. Attacker tries to beat him and finish or cross. Swap roles each round.

exercises.name: Cool-down
exercises.how: Hip flexor, quad, hamstring, glute stretch, 45 s each side.

exercises.name: Foam roll quads and glutes
exercises.how: Slow passes, pause on tight spots for 20-30 s. Roll the outer thigh lightly, not hard on the IT band.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switches
exercises.how: Sit tall, rotate both knees side to side with control.

exercises.name: Couch stretch (hip flexor/quad)
exercises.how: Rear knee on a mat, foot up on the wall or bench. Squeeze the glute. Each side.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.how: Lying leg raise with a strap or towel. Each side.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.how: Drive through the heels, pause 2 s at the top.

exercises.name: Side-lying leg raise / clamshell
exercises.how: Slow and controlled. Each side. Feel the outer hip, not the lower back.

exercises.name: Figure-4 glute stretch
exercises.how: Lying down, ankle over opposite knee. Each side.

exercises.name: Toe taps
exercises.how: Tap the top of the ball with alternate soles, light and fast on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Sole rolls, both feet
exercises.how: Roll the ball across your body with the sole, switch feet each time. Left foot leads on even rounds.

exercises.name: Inside-outside touches
exercises.how: Inside then outside of the same foot, moving forward. Round 2 left foot only.

exercises.name: Cone weave dribble
exercises.how: Weave through 5-6 markers a stride apart, every touch close. Back through with the left foot only.

exercises.name: Skill moves at speed
exercises.how: Drive at a marker, beat it with one move (step-over, scissors, drag-back, croqueta), accelerate 5 m. One move per round.

exercises.name: Receive on the half-turn
exercises.how: Play off a wall, open your body and take the first touch across you into space, then drive. Alternate sides.

exercises.name: Scan, receive and turn
exercises.how: Before each pass comes back off the wall, check over both shoulders, then turn away from an imagined defender.

exercises.name: Aerial control: self toss
exercises.how: Toss the ball high, kill it dead with foot, thigh or chest. Every third one with the left foot.

exercises.name: Long passing to a target
exercises.how: Strike 25-35 m diagonals at a target. Plant foot beside the ball, lock the ankle. Half with your weak foot.

exercises.name: Weak-foot finishing
exercises.how: Shots with your weaker foot only: set it, then strike low across the goal. Accuracy before power.

exercises.name: Volleys from a self feed
exercises.how: Toss the ball up, let it drop, volley at the target. Keep your knee over the ball.

exercises.name: Cut inside and finish
exercises.how: From the wing, cut inside onto your stronger foot and finish far post. Alternate wings.

exercises.name: Defensive jockey footwork
exercises.how: Side-on stance, short quick steps, backpedal and shuffle between markers. On LEFT or RIGHT, turn and sprint 5 m that way.

exercises.name: Acceleration starts (5-10 m)
exercises.how: From a standing, side-on or backwards start, explode for 5-10 m. Full recovery, every rep at max speed.

exercises.name: Lateral shuffle + sprint
exercises.how: Shuffle 3 m left, 3 m right, then sprint 10 m forward. Stay low through the shuffle.

exercises.name: Repeated sprints
exercises.how: 30 m sprints with short rest: match-like repeat-sprint ability. Stop if your speed drops off a lot.

exercises.name: Box-to-box runs
exercises.how: Run about 70 m at 80% pace, walk back. Builds the engine for 90 minutes.

exercises.name: Ball-at-feet intervals
exercises.how: Dribble at a high tempo around a large square, keep the ball close the whole time.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.how: Heavy but clean: 2 reps left in the tank. Drive up fast.

exercises.name: Trap bar deadlift
exercises.how: Push the floor away, stand up fast. Keep your back flat.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.how: Rear foot on a bench, front knee tracks over the toes. Hip and knee stability for cutting.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.how: Hinge back, soft knees, feel the hamstrings. Controlled down, strong up.

exercises.name: Nordic hamstring curl
exercises.how: Kneel with heels anchored, lower yourself as slowly as you can. Big hamstring-injury protector.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.how: Full range, pause at the top. Ankles and Achilles for sprinting.

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.how: Shoulder blades pinned, feet planted, bar to mid-chest.

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.how: Full hang to chin over the bar. Add weight when 8 feels easy.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead press
exercises.how: Ribs down, press straight up, no leaning back.

exercises.name: Bent-over row
exercises.how: Flat back, pull to the belly, squeeze the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.how: Body in one straight line, chest to a fist from the floor.

exercises.name: Box jump
exercises.how: Jump up explosively, land soft and quiet, step down. Quality over height.

exercises.name: Broad jump
exercises.how: Swing the arms, jump as far as you can, stick the landing.

exercises.name: Single-leg bounds
exercises.how: Bound forward on one leg, push hard off the ground. First-step power.

exercises.name: Med ball rotational throw
exercises.how: Side-on to a wall, rotate from the hips and throw hard. Shooting and turning power.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.how: Snap the hips, let the bell float to chest height. Hinge, not squat.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.how: Elbows under shoulders, squeeze glutes, no sagging.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank
exercises.how: Top leg on a bench, lift the hips. Groin-injury protector for footballers.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.how: Cable or band at chest height, press out and resist the twist.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.how: Lower back pressed into the floor, opposite arm and leg reach slowly.

exercises.name: Bike intervals
exercises.how: 30 seconds all-out on the bike, easy spin in the rest.

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.how: Low body angle, drive the knees. Acceleration strength.

exercises.name: Gym warm-up: bike + mobility
exercises.how: 5 min easy bike or row, then leg swings, hip openers and a few bodyweight squats.

exercises.name: Gym cool-down: stretch
exercises.how: Hip flexors, hamstrings, glutes, chest. Slow breathing.

exercises.name: Power clean
exercises.how: Bar from the floor, explode with the hips, catch high in a quarter squat. Speed, not grind.

exercises.name: Hang clean
exercises.how: Start at mid-thigh, jump and shrug, fast elbows. Easier to learn than the full clean.

exercises.name: Push jerk
exercises.how: Short dip, drive with the legs, punch the bar overhead and catch in a slight bend.

exercises.name: Split jerk
exercises.how: Dip and drive, split the feet front and back to catch. Alternate the front foot each set.

exercises.name: Hang snatch
exercises.how: Wide grip from mid-thigh, extend fully, pull under and catch overhead. Light weight, perfect positions.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell snatch
exercises.how: One explosive pull from the floor to overhead. A simpler snatch for power.

exercises.name: Jump squat
exercises.how: Light load or bodyweight, quarter dip and jump as high as you can. Land soft.

exercises.name: Trap bar jump
exercises.how: Light trap bar (20-30% of your deadlift), jump straight up, reset each rep.

exercises.name: Speed bench press
exercises.how: About 50-60% load, lower under control, press as fast as possible.

exercises.name: Landmine push press
exercises.how: Dip and drive the bar up from the shoulder in one explosive push.
needs: landmine or barbell in a corner

exercises.name: Med ball chest pass
exercises.how: Throw hard into a wall from the chest, catch and go again. Upper-body speed.

exercises.name: Med ball slam
exercises.how: Reach tall, slam the ball into the floor with everything.

exercises.name: Depth jump
exercises.how: Step off a low box, touch the floor and jump straight up instantly. Short ground contact.

exercises.name: Pogo hops
exercises.how: Stiff ankles, bounce off the balls of the feet. Quick and springy.

exercises.name: Hurdle hops
exercises.how: Hop over low hurdles in a row, minimal time on the ground.

exercises.name: Lateral bounds (skaters)
exercises.how: Bound sideways off one leg, stick the landing for a second. Cutting power.

exercises.name: Countermovement jump
exercises.how: Quick dip, swing the arms, jump for max height. Test-day jump too.

exercises.name: Plyometric push-up
exercises.how: Push the floor away hard enough that your hands leave the ground.

exercises.name: Acceleration sprints 10-20 m
exercises.how: Full speed from a standing start on the track or turf. Full rest: quality over fatigue.

exercises.name: Flying 20 m sprints
exercises.how: Build up over 20 m, then hit top speed for 20 m.

exercises.name: Resisted sprint (sled or band)
exercises.how: Light sled or band, drive the knees, lean forward. First-step power.

exercises.name: Half squat
exercises.how: Heavier than your full squat, down to thighs about 45 degrees. Strength in the range you sprint and jump.

exercises.name: Quarter squat
exercises.how: Heavy, short dip, drive up fast. Use safety bars.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.how: Elbows high, chest up, sit between the hips.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.how: Shoulders on a bench, drive the hips up, squeeze the glutes at the top. Sprint power.

exercises.name: Conventional deadlift
exercises.how: Bar over mid-foot, flat back, push the floor away.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.how: Hinge on one leg, reach the other leg back, hips square. Balance and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Step-up (knee drive)
exercises.how: Box at knee height, drive up through the front leg, finish with a knee drive.

exercises.name: Skater squat
exercises.how: Single-leg squat, back knee touches a pad behind you. Control on the way down.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell bench press
exercises.how: One dumbbell, resist the twist through your trunk.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
exercises.how: Hand on a bench, pull to the hip, no twisting.

exercises.name: Isometric split squat hold
exercises.how: Hold the bottom of a split squat, front thigh parallel. Knee and tendon strength.

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.how: Back flat on the wall, thighs parallel to the floor.

exercises.name: Isometric mid-thigh pull
exercises.how: Bar fixed at mid-thigh (or pinned in a rack), pull as hard as you can for 5 seconds.

exercises.name: Isometric long-lever bridge
exercises.how: Heels on a bench, legs nearly straight, lift the hips and hold. Hamstring protection.

templates.summary: One- and two-touch passing on the ground and in the air, then 1v1s.

items.how: Easy jog together, leg swings, lunges with a twist.

templates.summary: No ball. Loosen the hips and strengthen around the IT band.

templates.summary: Upper strength and a strong trunk for holding off defenders.

templates.summary: Lighter full-body session for weeks with games: fewer sets, nothing that leaves your legs heavy.
